entities.name: Johanna Gerarda Theodora van Eijbergen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johanna Gerarda Theodora van Eybergen was a Dutch artist specializing in applied arts and design, notable for her Art Nouveau work on metal. She was the first and for a long time the only Duch woman artist working on design on metal.
